qualification.B_a: derived from the retained commissioned per-axis 0.13 m/s^2 residual envelope
qualification.D_a: selected deterministic deployment limit; assembled-history qualification is open

magnetic_service.qualification: selected certification limits; source-uniform accepted informative service is open

sensor_model.qualification: deterministic commissioned BMI270 profile; A21 theorem admits 166.7--250 Hz sample timing [0.004,0.006] s; deployment qualification remains separate

a21_schedule.qualification: literal shipping clamps/cadence; pseudo scheduler retargets elapsed progress when tau changes

a21_retained_domain.qualification: strict inner proof domain: below the ~7 deg magnetic-refinement horizontal gate and below R_b-B_a=0.174833395 m/s^2 projection-inactive margin
